title: Bigg Boss Telugu 10 premieres with 16 contestants
description: The house welcomed its first batch of contestants including Debjani Modak, Thrigun, Singer Jhansi, and Sudheer Reddy as the new season kicked off in style.

title: First captaincy task turns dramatic
description: Contestants clashed during the opening captaincy task as alliances started forming in the house within the first few days.

title: Nagarjuna addresses the house on Weekend Mirchi
description: Host Akkineni Nagarjuna reviewed the week's events and pulled up contestants for their behavior during tasks.

title: Secret task keeps contestants on their toes
description: A surprise secret task was assigned to a few contestants, adding an extra layer of strategy to house dynamics this week.

title: First nominations of the season announced
description: Contestants faced the nomination process for the first time this season, setting the stage for the week's voting.
